name: kits_endgame
note: Endgame dungeon copies with the designed kits and priority rules (SKYGLASS_WRECK_ENCOUNTERS.md, SKYGLASS_BOSS_FIGHTS.md 1-2), built and schema-validated by engine/kits.ts.

dg-chain-hook.name: Chain Hook
dg-chain-hook.description: A weighted chain hooks a target, drags them in and pins them.
dg-chain-hook.battleDescription: %user hurls a weighted chain and drags %target across the deck.

dg-oath-of-stillness.name: Oath of Stillness
dg-oath-of-stillness.description: A binding oath that slows the target's footwork.
dg-oath-of-stillness.battleDescription: %user speaks the oath; %target's footing turns to stone.

dg-chart-mark.name: Chart Mark
dg-chart-mark.description: Marks a target on the chart; the crew converge on it.

dg-skyglass-aegis.name: Skyglass Aegis
dg-skyglass-aegis.description: A pane of skyglass forms around an ally.
dg-skyglass-aegis.battleDescription: %user raises a pane of skyglass around %target.

dg-mending-seal.name: Mending Seal
dg-mending-seal.description: A seal that knits wounds and lifts afflictions from an ally.

dg-ward-of-command.name: Ward of Command
dg-ward-of-command.description: The Sealwright's ward on the Captain: heavily reduced damage while she stands.

dg-warden-resolve.name: Warden's Resolve
dg-warden-resolve.description: Shared pool record EA03. Balance values pending sign-off.
dg-warden-resolve.battleDescription: %user sets his feet on the deck.

dg-first-blade-vanish.name: Glassveil Step
dg-first-blade-vanish.description: Shared pool record B09. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
dg-first-blade-vanish.battleDescription: %user steps behind a sheet of skyglass light and is gone.

dg-wayfinder-decoy.name: Afterimage Decoy
dg-wayfinder-decoy.description: Shared pool record B06. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
dg-wayfinder-decoy.battleDescription: %user leaves an afterimage on the chart lines.

dg-wayfinder-keelbind.name: Keelbind
dg-wayfinder-keelbind.description: Chakra moorings strike and anchor the target while draining health, chakra, and stamina over time.

dg-splintered-grasp.name: Splintered Grasp
dg-splintered-grasp.description: Heavy melee and a bleeding wound.
dg-splintered-grasp.battleDescription: Timber and rope lash out from the mass.

dg-bilge-spit.name: Bilge Spit
dg-bilge-spit.description: Range 5 (design: 4; widened so he always has a reply at range): damage and a poison.
dg-bilge-spit.battleDescription: A glob of black bilge arcs across the hold.

dg-collapse-mark.name: Collapse
dg-collapse-mark.battleDescription: The planks around it groan and split.

dg-collapse.name: Collapse
dg-collapse.description: The deck caves in around him.

dg-undertow.name: Undertow
dg-undertow.description: During a Collapse mark: a player is dragged 3 hexes toward him, into the ring.
dg-undertow.battleDescription: Black water drags %target toward the breach.

dg-rupture-a.name: Rupture Field
dg-rupture-a.battleDescription: The rot erupts through the floor.

dg-rupture-b.name: Rupture Field
dg-rupture-b.battleDescription: The rot erupts through the floor.

dg-rupture-c.name: Rupture Field
dg-rupture-c.battleDescription: The rot erupts through the floor.

dg-rupture2-a.name: Rupture Field
dg-rupture2-a.battleDescription: The rot erupts and pools on the deck.

dg-rupture2-b.name: Rupture Field
dg-rupture2-b.battleDescription: The rot erupts and pools on the deck.

dg-rupture2-c.name: Rupture Field
dg-rupture2-c.battleDescription: The rot erupts and pools on the deck.

dg-maw-mark-1.name: Maw of the Deep
dg-maw-mark-1.battleDescription: The water in the hold goes still. Three points of skyglass light remain.

dg-maw-mark-2.name: Maw of the Deep
dg-maw-mark-2.battleDescription: The water in the hold goes still. Three points of skyglass light remain.

dg-maw-1.name: Maw of the Deep
dg-maw-1.description: Black water and teeth rise everywhere but the stars; then the seam splits open (Exposed Seam: x3 damage taken for 1 round).
dg-maw-1.battleDescription: Black water and teeth rise from every plank. The mass splits open along a glowing seam.

dg-maw-2.name: Maw of the Deep
dg-maw-2.description: Black water and teeth rise everywhere but the stars; then the seam splits open (Exposed Seam: x3 damage taken for 1 round).
dg-maw-2.battleDescription: Black water and teeth rise from every plank. The mass splits open along a glowing seam.

dg-core-rebuilds.name: The Core Rebuilds
dg-core-rebuilds.battleDescription: Skyglass light floods the mass. It knits itself back together, wrong.

dg-hold-the-line.name: Hold the Line
dg-hold-the-line.description: An enduring command imprint sharpens offensive technique and lends greater force to attacks.
dg-hold-the-line.battleDescription: %user plants his blade on the deck. "Hold the line."

dg-last-stand-at-the-helm.name: Last Stand at the Helm
dg-last-stand-at-the-helm.description: Heightened strength of body and mind.
dg-last-stand-at-the-helm.battleDescription: "I have held this deck through worse than you."

dg-final-command.name: Final Command
dg-final-command.description: A crushing command strike disrupts the target's actions and attempts to suppress their bloodline effects.

dg-captain-keelbind.name: Keelbind
dg-captain-keelbind.description: Chakra moorings strike and anchor the target while draining health, chakra, and stamina over time.

dg-captain-windlash.name: Windlash Focus
dg-captain-windlash.description: Shared pool record EA03. Balance values pending sign-off.
dg-captain-windlash.battleDescription: %user draws a tight current of wind around their body until their sleeves snap and flutter. The gale rides every strike they throw, adding force to their next attacks.

dg-captain-unraveling.name: Unraveling Strike
dg-captain-unraveling.description: Shared pool record S31. Balance values pending sign-off.
dg-captain-unraveling.battleDescription: %user slips a blow past %target's guard and drives chakra into it like a wedge. Every enhancement wrapped around them comes apart at once.

dg-captain-writ.name: Suppression Writ
dg-captain-writ.description: A command seal weakens the target's attacks, leaves them more vulnerable, and impairs their healing ability.
dg-captain-writ.battleDescription: %user casts a suppression writ upon %target, its tightening script dulling their strikes, opening their guard, and disrupting their healing chakra.

dg-captain-refrain.name: Ruin Refrain
dg-captain-refrain.description: The ship's remembered destruction erupts across the battlefield as a chakra projection of shattering timbers and staggering impacts.
dg-captain-refrain.battleDescription: %user releases the ship's memory of ruin, sending a storm of fractured timbers and concussive chakra across the battlefield.

dg-captain-cataclysm.name: Explosive Tag Cataclysm
dg-captain-cataclysm.description: Shared pool record B14. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
dg-captain-cataclysm.battleDescription: %user flings a sheaf of explosive tags toward %target and ignites them with a single surge of chakra. The tags wrap around %target and detonate together in one deafening blast.

dg-captain-secondwind.name: Second Wind
dg-captain-secondwind.description: Shared pool record S35. Balance values pending sign-off.
dg-captain-secondwind.battleDescription: %user draws on a last reserve of chakra deep in the belly and breathes it out through their body. Their wounds begin to close and their footing steadies.

dg-captain-counter.name: Counter Stance
dg-captain-counter.description: A posture that returns what it receives.
dg-captain-counter.battleDescription: %user takes a counter stance; what strikes them answers for it.

dg-captain-stolen.name: Stolen Form
dg-captain-stolen.description: Shared pool record B07. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
dg-captain-stolen.battleDescription: %user locks eyes with %target and reads the flow of their chakra like brushwork on a scroll. With a quick run of hand seals, %user copies the strengths %target carries and makes them their own.

dg-ships-bell.name: Ship's Bell
dg-ships-bell.description: The great bell tolls: push 3 and a 1-round stun inside the ring.

dg-broadside-mark-a.battleDescription: %user raises a hand. "Run out the guns."

dg-raise-the-gunwale.name: Raise the Gunwale
dg-raise-the-gunwale.description: A barrier line of timber and seals; it has its own health.
dg-raise-the-gunwale.battleDescription: %user barks an order; the gunwale rises.

nCQETf-HNnbRec1OSY2-R.battleDescription: %user's containment seal splits, consuming the device in a piercing chakra blast that tears through the surrounding battlefield.
nCQETf-HNnbRec1OSY2-R.description: A containment seal ruptures, destroying the casting device in a piercing chakra blast that staggers nearby enemies.
